decisions.reason: rejected: 512 keys exceed the 64-key band the Pascal fused-attention emitter supports (wider rows would need online softmax rescaling across bands); keeping 3 unfused kernels.

rejected: candidate tile 8x64 leaves only 2 accumulator registers per thread (< 4): the inner loop would be shared-memory bound; keeping 4 unfused kernels (the 4096.0 KB of DRAM traffic saved does not compensate for the lost parallelism)

bias_add+relu consumes the matmul accumulator tile straight out of registers: the [512x1024] tile never reaches DRAM (4096.0 KB saved) and 2 launch(es) disappear; smem=8.0KB regs=52 threads=256 grid=128 occupancy=0.50 vs unfused smem=8.0KB regs=48 threads=256 grid=128 occupancy=0.63
